Under 'Individual Offensive Play / Puck Control' and 'Team Play / Offensive Skills' it lists 'Puck Management', and under 'Team Play/Defensive Skills' and 'Intangibles' it lists 'Communication'/'Communication Skills', matching exp26b-u15-014's cited section ('puck management and communication'). 'Retrievals' also appears under Team Play/Offensive Skills, supporting exp26b-u15-013's Puck recovery topic placement. This supports age/topic placement only; it does not certify these exact coordinates, distances, or any guaranteed outcome, and it is a skills-matrix slide, not a detailed rule or technique document.
